lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with primary blobs to create a grid-like arrangement of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper lateral flank characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (light upper margin, dark lower margin).
